peopleAlsoAsk.question: What is the current recommendation for children and adolescents ages 6-17 for physical activity?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet:
Recommendations for Kids

Kids 6-17 years old should get at least 60 minutes per day of moderate- to vigorous-intensity physical activity, mostly aerobic. Include vigorous-intensity activity on at least 3 days per week.Jan 19, 2024

peopleAlsoAsk.snippet:
Children and adolescents 6 to 17

This group needs 60 minutes or more of moderate-to-vigorous intensity physical activity each day, including: Aerobic activity: Most of the daily 60 minutes or more should include activities such as walking, running, or anything that makes their hearts beat faster.Dec 4, 2025

peopleAlsoAsk.question: What are the recommended physical activity guidelines for adults in China?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet:
Guidelines for Adults Aged 18–64 Years

Engage in 150–300 minutes of moderate-intensity or 75–150 minutes of vigorous-intensity aerobic activity per week, or an equivalent combination of moderate-intensity and vigorous-intensity aerobic activity. Engage in muscle-strengthening exercise at least two days a week.
